expectations.text: index.html honours prefers-reduced-motion by disabling or simplifying its motion (CSS media query or JS matchMedia check)
expectations.evidence: prefers-reduced-motion handled; reduced run shows a finished still frame

expectations.text: index.html's main headline and body copy are visible with JavaScript disabled (nothing essential is left hidden by CSS waiting for a script)
expectations.evidence: With scripts removed the wordmark, nav and intro copy all render (CSS gradient-text fallback)

expectations.text: index.html loads with no console errors
index.html animates only transform, opacity, clip-path or filter — no per-frame animation of top/left/width/height/margin
expectations.evidence: Static scan: no layout properties in @keyframes or tweens

expectations.text: index.html has no horizontal page scroll at a 390px-wide viewport
index.html varies entrance motion by element role (at least two distinct reveal treatments, e.g. line/mask reveal for headlines and scale/clip for media), rather than one identical fade-up everywhere
expectations.evidence: SplitText line masks for type, clip-path wipes for covers, scrubbed scale for the aurora, staggered count-ups

expectations.text: index.html uses no emoji and no default purple/indigo-to-blue/pink gradient
expectations.evidence: No emoji; gradients are on-brand aurora greens

expectations.text: index.html implements smooth scrolling (Lenis or an equivalent) that keeps native scroll and anchor links working
expectations.evidence: Lenis wired to ScrollTrigger; nav anchors scroll via lenis.scrollTo

expectations.text: index.html includes intro, 4 selected projects, a what-we-do section and contact details
expectations.evidence: Hero, statement, 4 projects (Polarnatt, Fjellgang, Kystlyd, Tindra), services, contact

expectations.text: index.html has a clearly identifiable signature moment (one standout interaction or scroll scene) rather than evenly distributed effects
expectations.evidence: Signature: canvas aurora inside the NORTHLIGHT wordmark that spills out to fill the screen while pinned
